<script type="text/javascript">
  (function (window) {
    window.__env = window.__env || {};

    function setEnvVar(key, val) {
      if (val === undefined) {
        console.warn(`Environment variable "${key}" is not set. Using default.`)
        return
      }

      window.__env[key] = val;
    }

    function setTitleFavicon(platform) {
      var favicon = document.getElementById('appFavicon');

      if (!favicon) return;

      if (platform === 'kraken') {
        document.title = 'Kraken Futures';
        favicon.setAttribute('href', `favicon-kraken.ico`);
      } else if (platform === 'cf') {
        document.title = 'Crypto Facilities';
        favicon.setAttribute('href', `favicon-cf.ico`);
      }
    }

    // API urls
    setEnvVar('platform', 'kraken');
    setEnvVar('appVersion', 'ec772647');
    setEnvVar('demo', false);
    setEnvVar('locales', ["en","ja","ru","es","zh","fr","tr","pt"]);
    setEnvVar('featuresEnabled', ["captcha", "ghost", "depthChart", "wsHealth", "flex", "mfaConfirm", "transferDestination", "fusionBanners"]);

    setEnvVar('urls', {
      rest: 'https://futures.kraken.com/derivatives/api/v4',
      websocket: 'wss://futures.kraken.com/ws/v1',
      auth: 'https://futures.kraken.com/api/auth/v1',
